kigam_source: KIGAM Geo Big Data Open Platform, Taean western offshore seabed geology dataset, 1:250,000 scale, 1994 publication
geoacoustic_source: APL-UW TR9407 High-Frequency Ocean Environmental Acoustic Models Handbook, Table 2 (p. IV-6), DTIC ADB199453, https://apps.dtic.mil/sti/tr/pdf/ADB199453.pdf -- standard secondary compilation of Hamilton (1980) geoacoustic sediment ratios. Literature class ratios are applied to this project's own reference water values (1024 kg/m^3, 1480 m/s); they are not site measurements.
